div.head: Swer 4
div.ab: Ðæs að, þe his æhte bryideð: þæt he hit ne dæð ne for hete ne for hole. On ðone Drihten, ne te ic Ñ ne for hete ne for hole ne for unrihtre feohgyrnesse, ne ic nan soðre nat, bute swa min secga me sæde, 7 ic sylf to soðe talige, þæt he mines orfes ðeof wære.

In omnipotenti Deo, non attraho mihi hoc N. pro amicitia uel inimicitia uel pro iniusto lucro, nec uerius inde scio, quam mihi sagemannus meus dixit, et ipse in ueritate loquor, quod pecunie mee latro fuit N.
On ðone Drihten, ne teo ic N. ne for hete ne for hole ne for unrihtre feohgyrnesse, ne ic nan soðre nat, bute swa min secga me sæde, 7 ic sylf to soðe talige, ðæt he mines orfes þeof wære.

(Eid dessen, der sein Werthstück im Anefang greift: dass er dies nicht aus Hass oder zur Verleumdung thut. B) Bei dem Herrn …, nicht bezichtige ich N. aus Hass oder zur Verleumdung oder aus ungerechter Geldgier, und ich weiss nichts Wahreres als wie mein Melder mir gesagt hat, und ich selbst als Wahrheit erachte, [nämlich] dass ér der Dieb meines Viehs gewesen sei.

(The oath of him who attaches his property: that he does not do it out of hatred or malice. B) By the Lord …, I do not accuse N. out of hatred or malice or out of unjust greed for money, nor do I know anything truer than what my informant told me and I myself hold to be true, [namely] that he was the thief of my cattle.

[I swear] by the Lord, [that] I do not accuse N. because of hatred or slander or out of avarice, and [I know] nothing more true than what my informant told me, and what I myself consider to be true: that N. stole my cattle.
div.note: B reads ‘te’ (so); H's ‘teo’ is corrected from ‘teo. c.’, and H's ‘hole’ altered from ‘hele’.
